upheld.detail: TC-02 and TC-03 assert toHaveCSS('color', rest) and then not.toHaveCSS('color', HIGHLIGHT), which the first assertion already implies; TC-06 checks page.url() equals startUrl and then re-checks its pathname; TC-04 asserts expect(entries).toHaveLength(12) on a literal array defined two lines above. upheld.requirement: PR check style guideline 2: no duplicated logic or unexplained complexity; neighbor specs (e2e/teststack/bug-30.spec.ts, bug-32.spec.ts) assert each fact once

upheld.title: Test plan index names scenario `default`, spec uses `bug-38`
upheld.detail: The plan's scope says every case runs on scenario `default`, while the PR adds .factory/stack/scenarios/bug-38 and the spec loads it with loadScenario('bug-38'). The plan and the automation disagree on which scenario is used.
upheld.requirement: Consistency between plan and automation, as in other stories where the spec header and the plan name the same scenario (e2e/teststack/bug-32.spec.ts:7)
